name: disnotify-backend
description: DisNotify API — price tracking, comparison and alerting. SCAFFOLD ONLY: every file under this folder is a guided stub for you to implement.

//deps.pg: PostgreSQL — products, offers, price_history, alerts, users
//deps.cheerio: fast HTML parsing for static retailer pages
//deps.playwright: ONLY for retailers that render prices with JavaScript (Best Buy, Micro Center)
//deps.node-cron: schedules the price refresh + alert evaluation jobs
//deps.web-push: sends browser push using your VAPID keys
//deps.resend: transactional email (swap for SendGrid/SMTP if you prefer)
//deps.p-queue: throttles concurrent scrape requests per retailer domain
